title: A Space website opens on a hero with presence: the name set poster-size over the cover, the tagline and town above it, the Space's own description under it, and Book plus Get in touch

source.ref: Owner review of danieltyack.com after LIVE-811, 2026-10-06: 'This got reverted back to the stone ages. I just wanted you to redo the hero with something that vibed'. Picked option A (Arrival) from three mockups. White label sites build ADR-1708

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-06. THE CONSEQUENCE: the LIVE-811 hero was a dark gradient with a small name and one button in the corner, so the first screen of a client's website read as a template rather than the business. THE FIX: SiteHero sets the name in the display face at poster size (up to 8.5rem), puts the tagline and town as an eyebrow above it (components/sites/site-hero-copy.ts siteHeroEyebrow), and the opening of the Space's own description under it (siteHeroLede: whole sentences up to 220 characters). The Book button sits beside a Get in touch outline button when the Space placed a contact block. The photo gets a side wash plus an accent glow from the bottom and a slow settle on load (none under reduced motion). Every field already exists on every Space, so each published website gets the hero with no new setup.

2026-10-07 (LIVE-830): the owner replaced this hero with the house theme's. It keeps the consequence: a poster-size headline over the cover (the owner's Hero headline, else the brand name), the owner's Hero line or the opening of the Space description under it, and the Space's own button. The tagline-and-town eyebrow went with the design.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const h=r('components/sites/house-home.tsx');const s=r('components/sites/house-sections.tsx');const x=r('components/sites/house-css.ts');if(!/siteHeroLede\\(space\\.about\\)/.test(h)||!/hero\\.heading \\|\\| brandName/.test(h))miss.push('the website hero is not built from the Space (headline, then its description)');if(!/clamp\\(3\\.4rem,8\\.4vw,7\\.2rem\\)/.test(x)||!/className=\"hs-h1\"/.test(s))miss.push('the website hero headline is not set poster-size');if(!/hs-btn-primary/.test(s)||!/hero\\.cta/.test(s))miss.push('the website hero has no booking button');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-812: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Re-pointed 2026-10-07 (LIVE-830): the same consequence (a hero with presence built from the Space) measured on the house theme.
